attempts_array.invalidated_reason: The repository-migration apply harness double-executed each migration (an outer psql piped to grep plus a second redirected psql). The second execution of migration #1 reported 'relation feeds already exists', and a subsequent fresh-DB apply partially committed feeds/accounts before erroring on 'schema auth does not exist'. These were harness artifacts (mis-targeting of the fresh disposable DB vs the bootstrapped DB), not genuine image or migration failures. This container was thereby invalidated and discarded before any migration result was relied upon.
